## How this index should be used

- The export is a **primary scene archive**, not omniscient narration. A character statement remains that character’s claim unless the scene independently establishes it.
- A **candidate session** is a mechanical review unit separated from the next message by more than 12 hours of inactivity. It is not automatically a canon quest, chapter, party, or adventure title.
- Dates below are calendar dates in the timestamps’ recorded UTC offsets. A row spanning two dates may represent one late-running scene; a one-message row may be an OOC marker, correction, or isolated post.
- Protected material—gods, ancient history, and origins such as Delerium’s—must remain behind the spoiler vault when synthesized into the public Codex. This public index therefore carries no transcript excerpts.
- Exact claims should cite message IDs or timestamps during future extraction. The original export, not this index, remains the evidentiary source.

This ledger makes the full quest channel auditable without pretending the transcript has already been completely interpreted.
